methods.name: Positive reinforcement (+R)
methods.description: Delivering a consequence the dog wants following a desired behaviour to increase future probability of that behaviour.

methods.name: Marker signal training
methods.description: Using a distinct signal (word, click, whistle, or visual) to pinpoint correct behaviour, always followed by reinforcement.

methods.name: Lure and fade
methods.description: Using food or target to elicit movement into position, then fading the lure as cue and reinforcement structure mature.

methods.name: Long-line training and management
methods.description: Using a long line attached to a harness to allow distance while preventing uncontrolled roaming during recall training.
